distribution.summary: 福建；黑龙江；贵州；江西；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Heilongjiang, Guizhou, Jiangxi, Yunnan, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence. Lin & Smith (2022) independently records Taiwan; this confirms Taiwan occurrence without changing the reviewed province-level mainland synthesis.

host_note: The synonym-style source annotation Cyclobalanopsis glauca [= Quercus glauca] is retained explicitly. Lin & Smith (2022) adds no promoted host evidence for this taxon.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion bodoanum (Reitter, 1913).
